subject: general
question: The Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana (MKSP), is a key sub-scheme under ____________.

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana (MKSP)** is a sub-scheme under **Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)**, aimed at empowering women farmers.
 
• It was introduced by the **Ministry of Rural Development** to promote sustainable agriculture and support women in the agricultural sector.
 
• The scheme is designed to enhance the livelihoods of **marginalized women farmers** through capacity building and improved access to resources and technology.
 
• MKSP emphasizes **sustainable agricultural practices** such as organic farming, soil fertility management, and water conservation.
 
• This initiative seeks to reduce dependency on external inputs and ensure food security by promoting eco-friendly farming techniques.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM):**

 
 
• Launched in **June 2011**, DAY-NRLM aims to alleviate rural poverty by creating sustainable livelihood options.
 
• It is a flagship program of the **Ministry of Rural Development**, and it focuses on building strong self-help groups (SHGs).
 
• DAY-NRLM provides financial assistance, training, and capacity building to SHGs to encourage entrepreneurship and self-reliance among rural communities.
 
• Women constitute **over 85%** of the program's beneficiaries, making it a cornerstone for women empowerment in rural India.
 
 
 
• **Other Government Schemes Related to Agriculture:**
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY):** Aims to increase agricultural productivity by ensuring water availability and efficient irrigation systems.
 
• **Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY):** Focuses on incentivizing states to invest more in agricultural development.
 
• **Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana:** Promotes organic farming and sustainable agricultural practices.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Agriculture Practices Promoted by MKSP:**
 
 
• Encourages **organic farming** to reduce dependence on chemical fertilizers and pesticides.
 
• Promotes **crop diversification** and mixed cropping to enhance soil fertility and reduce risks.
 
• Advocates for **water conservation techniques**, such as rainwater harvesting and micro-irrigation.
 
• Focuses on the use of **locally available resources** to reduce input costs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Eligibility:** MKSP primarily targets **women farmers** from marginalized communities, including SC/ST groups and other economically disadvantaged sections.
 
• **Funding:** The program is funded jointly by the **Central Government** and participating states, ensuring shared responsibility and accountability.
 
• **Implementation:** The scheme is implemented through various **community-based organizations**, SHGs, and NGOs working in rural areas.
 
• **Monitoring:** A robust monitoring and evaluation framework is in place to measure the impact of MKSP on women farmers' livelihoods and agricultural productivity.
